warning: Settlement address is a Kraken deposit: USDC on Base ONLY, min 2.5 USDC; other tokens or networks sent DIRECTLY to this 0x are lost. Shieldz tips settle as USDC on Base to that address.
manage_token: REMOVED 2026-09-22 - never store a manage token in this public repo. See secrets_note.
secrets_note: The token Shieldz returns at creation is a capability: holding it IS access to the jar's manage view. Elons Twin committed it here on 2026-09-21 and it was public until 2026-09-22. Recreating the jar does NOT rotate it: Shieldz keys a keyless jar to the wallet address, so the same address returns the same slug and refuses to re-disclose the token. The only real fix is to claim the keyless account from the Shieldz dashboard with a signed-in wallet or email, which is Jaron's to do and is not urgent: Shieldz is non-custodial, tips settle on-chain to the Kraken address, and no token reaches Kraken or any other account of his.
